title: CreateSAMLProviderResponse

allOf.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the new SAML provider resource in IAM.
A list of tags that are attached to the new IAM SAML provider. The returned list of tags is sorted by tag key. For more information about tagging, see Tagging IAM resources in the IAM User Guide.

description: Contains the response to a successful CreateSAMLProvider request.
